theorem ReviewI.LocalArithmetic.both_tests_large_log_step.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ),
  Continuous phi →
    HasCompactSupport phi →
      (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x = 0 → phi x = 0) →
        ∃ R,
          0 ≤ R ∧
            ∀ (q : Fin 2) (g : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
              R < |Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K g| →
                (∀ (n : ℤ), LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (g ^ n) = 0) ∧
                  ∀ (c : ℤ → ℂ), HasSum (fun n => c n * LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (g ^ n)) 0 :=
fun K [Field K] [NumberField K] phi hh hc hphi =>
  Exists.casesOn
    (ReviewI.LocalArithmetic.compact_log_support_bound K (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi 0)
      (LIntegrated.requiredTest_compact K phi hh hc 0).right)
    fun R0 h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hR0 hb0 =>
      Exists.casesOn
        (ReviewI.LocalArithmetic.compact_log_support_bound K (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi 1)
          (LIntegrated.requiredTest_compact K phi hh hc 1).right)
        fun R1 h =>
        And.casesOn h fun left hb1 =>
          Exists.intro (max R0 R1)
            ⟨LE.le.trans hR0 (le_max_left R0 R1), fun q g hg =>
              have hzero := fun n =>
                List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x =>
                  List.finRange 2 = a → Fintype.complete q ≍ x → LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (g ^ n) = 0)
                  (Fintype.complete q)
                  (fun as h =>
                    List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun q =>
                        ∀ (this : q ∈ Fintype.elems),
                          (fun x1 x2 => (fun i => i) x1 :: x2) ⟨1, Nat.le_refl 2⟩ [] ≍ as →
                            this ≍ List.Mem.head as → LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (g ^ n) = 0)
                        (fun this tail_eq =>
                          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                            this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                              LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.le_refl 2)⟩) (g ^ n) =
                                0)
                            (fun h =>
                              ReviewI.LocalArithmetic.large_log_step_vanishes K (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi 0) R0
                                hb0 (LIntegrated.requiredTest_at_one K phi hphi 0) g
                                (LE.le.trans_lt (le_max_left R0 R1) hg) n)
                            (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
                        (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete q))
                  (fun b {as} a h =>
                    List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
                        (fun x1 x2 => (fun i => i) x1 :: x2) ⟨1, Nat.le_refl 2⟩ [] ≍ as →
                          Fintype.complete q ≍ List.Mem.tail b a → LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (g ^ n) = 0)
                        (fun tail_eq =>
                          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                            ∀ (a : List.Mem q as),
                              Fintype.complete q ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.le_refl 2)⟩) a →
                                LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (g ^ n) = 0)
                            (fun a h =>
                              List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 x =>
                                (fun x1 x2 => (fun i => i) x1 :: x2) ⟨1, Nat.le_refl 2⟩ [] = a_1 →
                                  a ≍ x → LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (g ^ n) = 0)
                                a
                                (fun as h =>
                                  List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                                    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun q =>
                                      ∀ (a : List.Mem q ((fun x1 x2 => (fun i => i) x1 :: x2) ⟨1, Nat.le_refl 2⟩ [])),
                                        [] ≍ as → a ≍ List.Mem.head as → LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (g ^ n) = 0)
                                      (fun a tail_eq =>
                                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                                          a ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                                            LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi ((fun i => i) ⟨1, Nat.le_refl 2⟩) (g ^ n) =
                                              0)
                                          (fun h =>
                                            ReviewI.LocalArithmetic.large_log_step_vanishes K
                                              (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi 1) R1 hb1
                                              (LIntegrated.requiredTest_at_one K phi hphi 1) g
                                              (LE.le.trans_lt (le_max_right R0 R1) hg) n)
                                          (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
                                      (eq_of_heq head_eq) a)
                                (fun b {as} a_1 h =>
                                  List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                                    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
                                      [] ≍ as → a ≍ List.Mem.tail b a_1 → LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (g ^ n) = 0)
                                      (fun tail_eq =>
                                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                                          ∀ (a_2 : List.Mem q as),
                                            a ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨1, Nat.le_refl 2⟩) a_2 →
                                              LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (g ^ n) = 0)
                                          (fun a_2 h =>
                                            List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x =>
                                              [] = a → a_2 ≍ x → LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (g ^ n) = 0) a_2
                                              (fun as h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h))
                                              (fun b {as} a h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h))
                                              (Eq.refl []) (HEq.refl a_2))
                                          (eq_of_heq tail_eq) a_1)
                                      (eq_of_heq head_eq))
                                (Eq.refl ((fun x1 x2 => (fun i => i) x1 :: x2) ⟨1, Nat.le_refl 2⟩ [])) (HEq.refl a))
                            (eq_of_heq tail_eq) a)
                        (eq_of_heq head_eq))
                  (Eq.refl (List.finRange 2)) (HEq.refl (Fintype.complete q));
              ⟨hzero, fun c =>
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun x => HasSum x 0)
                      (funext fun n => Eq.trans (congrArg (HMul.hMul (c n)) ((fun n => hzero n) n)) (mul_zero (c n)))))
                  hasSum_zero⟩⟩
